purpose: one-call visual grounding plumbing check; excluded from every efficiency allocation
retry_policy: no retry after any call starts

image.construction: synthetic static form screenshot drawn with Pillow; no browser, external request, or model call

scoring.pass: status identified and each returned point lies inside its corresponding hidden box
scoring.partial: exactly one returned point lies inside its box
scoring.fail: neither point lies inside its box, malformed output, timeout, or incomplete call record

forbidden_inference: this preflight provides no task execution, effect, input release, latency comparison, token-economy, or live-browser evidence
